'''Tony Rachaun Bobbitt''' (born October 22, 1979) is a former American professional [[basketball]] player.

Bobbitt played alongside [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA) player [[Vince Carter]] at Daytona Beach [[Mainland High School]], where he graduated in 1999.<ref>{{cite news |author1=Kevin Hall |title=Bobbitt bounces back |url=https://www.newspapers.com/clip/98994531/ |access-date=3 April 2022 |work=[[Times-News (Idaho)|The Times-News]] |date=3 September 2000 |pages=C1, C7 |via=[[Newspapers.com]]}} {{open access}}</ref> Bobbitt played for the College of Southern Idaho (NJCAA) from 2000 to 2002<ref>{{cite news |author1=Jason Williams |title=Demon slayer |url=https://www.newspapers.com/clip/98994834/ |access-date=3 April 2022 |work=[[The Cincinnati Post]] |date=10 October 2002 |pages=1C, 3C |via=[[Newspapers.com]]}} {{open access}}</ref> and then transferred to the [[University of Cincinnati]] for his junior and senior years.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.orlandosentinel.com/news/os-xpm-2000-06-04-0006040147-story.html|title=Tony Bobbitt is down to his last chance|newspaper=[[Orlando Sentinel]]|first=Steve|last=Eling|date=June 4, 2000|access-date=July 16, 2021 |via=[[Newspapers.com]]}} {{open access}}</ref><ref name=kehe_12102006/><ref>{{cite news |author1=Paul Daugherty |title=Guard takes the pain, then dishes some out |url=https://www.newspapers.com/clip/98995045/guard-takes-the-pain-then-dishes-some-o/ |access-date=3 April 2022 |work=[[The Cincinnati Enquirer]] |date=14 March 2004 |pages=B1, B5}}</ref> As a senior with the [[Cincinnati Bearcats men's basketball|Bearcats]], Bobbitt averaged 13.3 honors.<ref>{{cite news|first=Bill|last=Koch|title=Maxiell named second-team all-conference|newspaper=The Cincinnati Enquirer|page=B5|url=https://www.newspapers.com/clip/81893777/|access-date=July 21,
